page_title: Social Media Management Tool for Multiple Accounts | SocialBu

sources.entry: SocialBu – AI-powered social media management platform for scheduling, publishing, monitoring, and automating across X, Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, TikTok, and more

summary.name: SocialBu
summary.one_liner: SocialBu is a social media management platform for scheduling, publishing, responding to, automating, and analyzing posts across multiple connected accounts, with an MCP server for AI assistant access.
keywords: x instagram linkedin facebook tiktok scheduling
use_cases: Schedule posts across multiple social accounts
Respond to comments and messages from one inbox
Share approved team posts with permission controls
Compare social media performance across accounts
summary.what_it_does: SocialBu lets users create posts for multiple connected accounts, customize network-specific options, and either publish immediately, schedule a time, or add content to a queue. It includes AI tools to draft and refine captions, which can be edited before publishing. Curate collects content from followed sources and turns selected links into drafts, while Listen tracks keywords and mentions on supported sources. Respond gathers supported messages, comments, and reviews into one inbox with assignment, status, and private notes. Automate builds rules around RSS feeds, supported social activity, and webhooks, and Analyze provides account, network, content, and team reports for a chosen date range.
notable: MCP server lets compatible AI assistants create posts and manage tasks in natural language
Team collaboration with permissions and approval before publishing, without sharing passwords
RSS, social activity, and webhook-based automation rules
caveats: Team and account limits depend on the plan
Available analytics metrics depend on what each connected network provides
Respond and Listen cover only supported message, comment, and source types
